fact: Burundian company Hyphen Tech developed the AgriHyphen AI app, a machine-learning tool that recognises 37 diseases across seven crops and is in use by farmers, according to Global South World.
The AI4Mpox Burundi team developed a machine-learning-ready epidemiological dataset and is piloting an AI early-warning dashboard.

The Ijwi ry'Ikirundi AI repository publishes a free public version of a Kirundi dataset (1,813 sentences with AI drafts, CC BY-NC 4.0), from a private full set of 4,809 sentences and 2,996 complete Kirundi-French-English pairs, and names its own NLLB-based Kirundi translation model.
